start_here: Say to your AI: "Forget part of what is kept about how this person writes", with {"all_edits":true}. It runs tool:forget-voice and answers {"forgot":1,"said":"Forgot 1."}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (voice-profile, voice-edit) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Forget part of what is kept about how this person writes", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:forget-voice and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Forgets one profile (profile_id from tool:read-voice), one edit (edit_id from tool:read-voice), or every edit (all_edits true, with kind to forget only one kind's).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: voice-profile (records:read, records:write); voice-edit (records:read, records:list, records:write).
